Do I need a doctor's referral?
No. You can book directly. If we think you need a scan or a doctor, we will say so and write to them.
Will it hurt?
Sometimes a little during, rarely much after. Nothing happens that you have not agreed to first.
Can I claim it back?
Most supplementary insurance covers physiotherapy. We give you an itemised receipt for the claim.
